title: Medical Arrangement
transcript:
Speaker 1: Good morning. Doctor Smith speaking. How can I help you?
Speaker 2: Well, I've been getting headaches frequently, so I'd like to get some advice.
Speaker 1: Okay. Firstly, how did you hear about us?
Speaker 2: My friend, Mrs Harris, told me that you did some good work for her a couple of years ago. Do you remember?
Speaker 1: Oh yes, I remember Mrs. Harris. I appreciate her compliment. So tell me about your headaches.
Speaker 2: The headaches usually last about a week. Sometimes it is so severe that I can't continue my work. Could you tell me what is going wrong?
Speaker 1: Sorry to hear that. We will have to look further into this. I want to know, did you have headaches before?
Speaker 2: No, I didn't suffer headaches previously. I've just been having them recently, perhaps for three months or so.
Speaker 1: I see. Well, I suggest that you should have an optic examination first. Do you know where the local optic examination center is?
Speaker 2: No. I haven't been there before. Would you please tell me how to get there?
Speaker 1: Of course. From here, you go along Shore Lane. You will see some crossroads, but remember to take a turn on the third one. Then go straight down Bridge Street. Keep going and then turn left at the first traffic light. It is right there.
Speaker 2: Got it.
Speaker 1: Now what I'll do is fill in a form with you to find out a little bit more about your medical history and so forth.
Speaker 2: Okay thank you.
Speaker 1: So first of all can I take your name?
Speaker 2: It's Anu Bhatt.
Speaker 1: Could you spell it please?
Speaker 2: Yes a n u b h a t t.
Speaker 1: And where do you live?
Speaker 2: Oh, I live in my parents' house on 21 Eagle Road. That's E A G L E Road, London.
Speaker 1: Oh, I often go to London on weekends too. It's a lovely city. And what's the postcode there?
Speaker 2: AL21DY.
Speaker 1: Now I need to know your family medical history. Have either of your parents had any medical problems?
Speaker 2: Yes. My mother has shellfish allergies while my dad doesn't. Oh, right. Both of my parents have had toothache for most of their lives.
Speaker 1: Okay, thanks. There is one more thing I need to take care of. Have you had an allergic reaction to any medicines before?
Speaker 2: No, that hasn't happened before.
Speaker 1: Okay, I'll make a note of that. I'll write none here. I think we are finished here for now.
Speaker 2: Thank you. See you later.
Speaker 1: See you then.
